prompt: You operate a Google Slides presentation. READING: Slides renders each slide to a CANVAS/SVG, but Google publishes a same-origin server-rendered full-text export at /export/html. slides.read returns EVERY slide's structured text and notes. slides.current_slide.textboxes.read is the blind-first current-slide map: it returns each rendered text box's object identity, text, and semantic role where detectable. Use it before editing; do not pixel-hunt. SLIDE STRUCTURE: slides.slide.create and slides.slide.duplicate use visible toolbar/menu controls and verify exact +1 server-backed slide-count deltas. WRITING text: prefer slides.current_slide.textbox.set, which resolves role first and exact existing text second, derives fresh DOM geometry internally, replaces the box, and verifies the requested slide through /export/html. slides.textbox.paste remains the lower-level action only when a box is already in edit mode. Set the deck title via the Rename input. Never navigate or reload while a text box is in edit mode. VERIFY every write by independently re-reading with slides.read after the server export settles.

Write: double-click the target text box on the canvas (enters edit mode + focuses the inner .docs-texteventtarget-iframe contenteditable), then clipboard.paste target {frame:'.docs-texteventtarget-iframe', selector:"[contenteditable='true']"}. Rich content: pass an html flavor to clipboard.paste (0.1.155+). Title/subtitle boxes are the default title-slide placeholders; the frame path reaches whichever box is in edit mode. Both prove an exact +1 count in /export/html before reporting verified. /export/html regenerates server-side and can lag ~1-2s after an edit — settle before re-reading.

tools.name: slides.map
tools.description: Return operating guidance for the Google Slides presentation map. Call this FIRST, before any other slides action.

static_output.read: slides.read { deck_id } — fetches /export/html (page.fetch, same-origin) and returns { deck_title, slide_count, slides:[{ slide, title, text:[…], notes }] } for EVERY slide, including speaker notes. This is a full-deck text projection, not a first-slide peephole. Screenshot only for exact visual layout or non-text elements. deck_id = URL segment after /presentation/d/.
static_output.write_text: Call slides.current_slide.textboxes.read, then slides.current_slide.textbox.set { deck_id, slide_number, role, existing_text?, text }. The setter resolves semantic role first and falls back to exact normalized existing text only when no role match exists. It fails closed on missing or ambiguous identity and derives fresh click geometry internally. Use slides.textbox.paste only when the intended box is already in edit mode.
static_output.verify: The coordinate-free setter compares the requested slide in /export/html before and after replacement. Independently call slides.read after a brief settle and confirm the requested slide's exact text. Screenshot only for visual layout or non-text elements.
recommended_sequence: slides.read { deck_id } — full deck: every slide's title, text runs, and notes
slides.current_slide.textboxes.read — inspect the selected slide's role/text identities
slides.current_slide.textbox.set — replace one exact role/text identity without caller coordinates
static_output.caveat: Slides ignores synthetic keyboard chords for canvas shortcuts (Ctrl+M/Ctrl+D won't add/duplicate slides) — use the toolbar '+' control. New decks show a 'Let's start creating' modal that ignores Escape; close its X (DPR-corrected coords). Screenshot is ~1.25x the viewport — scale click coords down, or resolve controls by identity.

tools.name: slides.read
tools.description: Read a Google Slides deck's FULL text — every slide's title, text runs, and speaker notes. Slides paints to a canvas so the live DOM is empty, but Google publishes a same-origin server-rendered export at /export/html; this fetches and parses it into { deck_title, slide_count, slides:[{ slide, title, text:[…runs…], notes }] }. This is a real whole-deck projection, not a first-slide summary. Use it to see all slide content; screenshot only for exact visual layout or non-text elements (images/charts). Pass deck_id = the URL segment after /presentation/d/ (e.g. from https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/ABC123/edit, deck_id is ABC123).

deck_id.description: The presentation id from the tab URL (segment after /presentation/d/).

tools.name: slides.current_slide.textboxes.read
tools.description: Read the text boxes rendered on the currently selected Google Slides slide without screenshots or caller-supplied canvas coordinates. Returns the selected slide number and one row per visible top-level Slides object with its stable object_id, normalized current text, and semantic role when the empty placeholder identifies title, subtitle, or body. Use this before slides.current_slide.textbox.set and copy exact existing_text when no semantic role is available.

workflow.output: {% ( $compact := function($s) { $lowercase($replace($s, /[\s\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u00A0]+/, '')) }; $role := function($text) { ( $key := $compact($text); $key = 'clicktoaddtitle' ? 'title' : ($key = 'clicktoaddsubtitle' ? 'subtitle' : ($key = 'clicktoaddtext' ? 'body' : null)) ) }; $items := $append([], steps.extractTextboxes.output.items); { 'slide_number': $number(steps.readSelectedSlide.output.text), 'textboxes': $count($items) > 0 ? $append([], $map($items, function($box) { { 'object_id': $box.object_id, 'role': $role($box.text), 'text': $box.text } })) : [], 'count': $count($items), 'complete': true, 'next_step': 'Choose role when present; otherwise copy one exact text value as existing_text into slides.current_slide.textbox.set. Never supply canvas coordinates.' } ) %}

tools.name: slides.current_slide.textbox.set
tools.description: Replace exactly one text box on the currently selected Google Slides slide without caller-supplied coordinates. Resolves semantic role (title, subtitle, or body) first; only when no role match exists does it fall back to exact normalized existing_text from slides.current_slide.textboxes.read. Requires exactly one identity-bound current-slide match and the requested selected slide number before mutation. It double-clicks fresh DOM-derived geometry, selects the active box contents with trusted editor input, pastes the replacement through Slides' editor iframe, and verifies an exact text-box delta on the requested slide through /export/html. On any failure or rate limit, call slides.read before deciding whether another mutation is safe.

deck_id.description: Presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

slide_number.description: The currently selected slide number, copied from slides.current_slide.textboxes.read.

role.description: Preferred semantic placeholder role. Used before existing_text.

existing_text.description: Exact current text copied from slides.current_slide.textboxes.read. Used only when the requested role has no match.

text.description: Complete replacement text for the resolved text box.

tools.name: slides.slide.create
tools.description: Create exactly one slide through Google Slides' visible New slide toolbar button, then verify the server-rendered deck slide count increased by exactly one. This is the reliable replacement for synthetic Ctrl+M, which Slides ignores on its canvas surface.

deck_id.description: Presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

workflow.output: {% ( $marker := '<div role="group" class="slide"'; $before := $count($split(steps.fetchBeforeStable.output.body, $marker)) - 1; $after := $count($split(steps.fetchAfter.output.body, $marker)) - 1; $verified := steps.fetchBeforeStable.output.status = 200 and steps.fetchAfter.output.status = 200 and $after = $before + 1; { 'created': $verified, 'before_count': $before, 'after_count': $after, 'verified': $verified, 'next_step': $verified ? 'New slide verified by an exact +1 server-backed slide-count delta; independently confirm with slides.read.' : 'New slide was not proven. Do not retry until slides.read establishes the current count, because create is non-idempotent.' } ) %}

tools.name: slides.slide.duplicate
tools.description: Duplicate the currently selected slide through Google Slides' visible Slide menu and its structurally identified Duplicate slide item, then verify the server-rendered deck slide count increased by exactly one. The current filmstrip selection determines which slide is duplicated.

deck_id.description: Presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

workflow.output: {% ( $marker := '<div role="group" class="slide"'; $before := $count($split(steps.fetchBeforeStable.output.body, $marker)) - 1; $after := $count($split(steps.fetchAfter.output.body, $marker)) - 1; $verified := steps.fetchBeforeStable.output.status = 200 and steps.fetchAfter.output.status = 200 and $after = $before + 1; { 'duplicated': $verified, 'before_count': $before, 'after_count': $after, 'verified': $verified, 'next_step': $verified ? 'Duplicate verified by an exact +1 server-backed slide-count delta; independently confirm the selected slide and new copy with slides.read.' : 'Duplicate was not proven. Do not retry until slides.read establishes the current count, because duplication is non-idempotent.' } ) %}

tools.name: slides.textbox.paste
tools.description: Paste text into the Google Slides text box that is CURRENTLY in edit mode. PRECONDITION: double-click the target text box on the canvas first so its inner editor iframe is focused. The workflow reads /export/html before and after paste and verifies that the exact text occurrence count increased; independently call slides.read afterward. For rich content, also pass html.

deck_id.description: Presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

text.description: Plain text to paste into the focused text box.

html.description: Optional exact text/html flavor for rich content (e.g. formatted runs). Omit for plain text.

workflow.output: {% ( $before := $count($split(steps.fetchBefore.output.body, input.text)) - 1; $after := $count($split(steps.verifyFetch.output.body, input.text)) - 1; { 'pasted': input.text, 'accepted': steps.paste.output.default_prevented, 'html_provided': steps.paste.output.html_provided, 'before_count': $before, 'after_count': $after, 'verified': steps.verifyFetch.output.status = 200 and $after > $before, 'next_step': ($after > $before) ? 'Paste verified by increased exact-text count in /export/html; independently confirm slide identity with slides.read.' : 'Paste did not verify in server-backed deck state. Do not claim success; restore edit-mode focus and retry only after slides.read.' } ) %}

tools.name: slides.getting_started.close
tools.description: Close the Google Slides 'Getting started' / 'Let’s start creating' modal when it appears on a new deck. This modal blocks deck editing and can make title/text actions report success without a saved slide-state change. Safe no-op if no matching close button is visible.

workflow.output: {% ( $wasPresent := $exists(steps.findClose.output.clickable_center.x); $stillPresent := steps.verifyClosed.output.match_count > 0; { 'closed': $wasPresent and $not($stillPresent), 'not_present': $not($wasPresent), 'next_step': ($wasPresent and $not($stillPresent)) ? 'Getting-started modal close verified; continue with the intended Slides write.' : ($not($wasPresent) ? 'No getting-started modal was present.' : 'Modal still appears present; do not continue with a write.') } ) %}

tools.name: slides.title_slide.set
tools.description: Fill the default title-slide placeholders on the current Google Slides deck, then verify through the server-rendered /export/html read path. This owns the missing state transition that slides.textbox.paste does not: it closes the new-deck modal if present, double-clicks the canvas title placeholder (#editor-i0), pastes title text into the editor iframe, double-clicks the subtitle placeholder (#editor-i1), pastes subtitle text, and verifies both strings are present in the exported deck text. Use this for first-slide artifact creation instead of telling the agent to manually double-click a text box.

deck_id.description: The presentation id from the URL segment after /presentation/d/.

title.description: Title text to place in the default title placeholder.

subtitle.description: Subtitle/body text to place in the default subtitle placeholder.

workflow.output: {% ( $decode := function($b) { $replace($replace($replace($replace($replace($replace($b, '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), ''', "'"), '—', '—') }; $before := $decode(steps.fetchBefore.output.body); $after := $decode(steps.verifyFetch.output.body); $tb := $count($split($before, input.title)) - 1; $ta := $count($split($after, input.title)) - 1; $sb := $count($split($before, input.subtitle)) - 1; $sa := $count($split($after, input.subtitle)) - 1; $verified := steps.verifyFetch.output.status = 200 and $ta > $tb and $sa > $sb; { 'title': input.title, 'subtitle': input.subtitle, 'title_paste_accepted': steps.pasteTitle.output.default_prevented, 'subtitle_paste_accepted': steps.pasteSubtitle.output.default_prevented, 'title_before_count': $tb, 'title_after_count': $ta, 'subtitle_before_count': $sb, 'subtitle_after_count': $sa, 'verified': $verified, 'fetch_status': steps.verifyFetch.output.status, 'next_step': $verified ? 'Title slide verified by increased exact-text counts in /export/html; independently confirm slide 1 with slides.read.' : 'Title slide did NOT verify as a server-backed state transition. Do not claim success; inspect edit-mode focus and placeholder geometry.' } ) %}
